qrels_generation.rule: topic membership: relevance >= 2 for the topic's own document, relevance 1 for a paired-topic document, explicit distractors; missing (query_id, document_id) pairs imply relevance 0

notes: SYNTHETIC benchmark dataset: relevance is rule-assigned by topic membership, not by human judges.
The qrels are frozen and committed; they are independent of the FTS boolean operator (OR/AND) and of any lexical all-terms-in-document rule.
Results produced on this dataset are development evidence only and are NOT a production-quality or human-quality certification.
The canonical human M2 qrels are private and are intentionally never used by this harness.
